name: R14 Magical Thief Adder's Oops Board

system.description:
+1D to your "Prop Analyze" and "Prop Disable" against Props with the [Magic] tag. When you use "Elemental Shell", you may change its targets to "[your Hate] ÷2 targets (minimum 1)". In addition to its usual chosen effect, your "Elemental Shell" also grants [Cancel] against [Fairy]. Witch's Board The legendary thief Adera's favorite Witch's Board, which has broken through many Alvean ruins. It is composed of a silver plate with secret runes engraved on it, about 20 centimeters in diameter, and a small heart-shaped ivory piece. It grants the user wisdom to overcome magical difficulties.

Silver Disc [Core Material] (380G) + Buttercup Charm (410G) + Orange Ring (640G) + [Magic Catalyst 14] (190G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (820G)
